commands: Telegram /voice QUESTION: audio only on success; text fallback
Telegram /voice: read the latest successful answer as audio; text fallback
Telegram text request: generate/select images for actual photo attachment

inputs: job mapping with id and prompt; optional existing chat/user fields
outputs: status succeeded or failed and response text; exact native session retained

storage.namespace: Bot/project outputs Telegram state; media.sqlite3 and media/<job>/ snapshots separate from jobs DB; optional credentials at XDG_CONFIG_HOME/senai/voice/<project-hash>.json outside project/Git
storage.migration_notes: Additive independent uploads and voice_requests tables in media.sqlite3; existing Telegram jobs/users/sessions/cursors and text delivery_snapshots retained. No legacy data deletion. Optional version-1 protected voice JSON lives outside the project/Git, separate from Telegram credentials; no database migration. Additive voice_delivery(job_id,outcome) table in media.sqlite3 records audio/fallback decisions; existing jobs/media/text cursors and protected voice JSON untouched.

limitations: --voice-check verifies local availability/permissions only, not API authorization/billing/audio quality.
Changes apply at startup; a running bot needs an operator-managed graceful restart. No restart/merge was performed.
Existing image/media limits and at-least-once delivery behavior remain unchanged.
Voice upload failures choose text fallback; fatal authorization errors cannot deliver either format.
Remote acceptance followed by network/local-cursor failure can remain ambiguous; no exactly-once guarantee.
delivery_scope: Voice-only /voice success with durable text fallback; optional protected key setup retained.
external_services: Optional OpenAI Speech API: dedicated env key, saved protected voice file, then generic OpenAI env key; local setup/check makes no network call.
Installed Codex built-in image generation when available; no image API client/key added

coordinator_integration.cli_conflict_resolution: Protected voice loading plus existing bounded cron/session and independent delivery hooks
